issue_request: FHIR-54325 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for Immunization.statusReason. The final PHWG decision kept the element name but changed the short, definition, comment, and invariant so statusReason applies when an immunization was not done or was entered in error.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists immunization=Immunization, so the edited Immunization files are in current build scope. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflict or narrowing decision.
